nhan_vat.lehoan: Le Hoan, a broad-shouldered Vietnamese man of about 49 with a square weathered friendly face, thick straight eyebrows, a short dark beard, hair tied up under a plain dark headcloth, wearing a dark-brown crossed-collar tunic with a plain sash, firm calm dignified look, empty hands, no weapon

nhan_vat.tong_quan: a proud Song official of about 50, lean, with a pointed chin beard and a smug raised chin, wearing a purple round-collared robe with a wide belt and a black official hat with two straight flat wings
nhan_vat.tong_de: the Song emperor on a grand throne, a middle-aged man in a yellow robe and a flat-topped crown with hanging bead strings, calm and remote
nhan_vat.dinh_lien: Dinh Lien, a handsome young prince of about 20 in a rich dark-red robe with a golden sash and a small crown, confident friendly look
nhan_vat.dinh_vuong: King Dinh Tien Hoang, a stern dignified man of about 55 with a full dark beard, wearing a golden-yellow robe and a tall ornate crown, powerful presence
